floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Lana on the Park apartment layout
floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. Several printed totals differ from the displayed component sums. Both total columns for 2 BR Type C show 1,028.49 sq ft. The selector uses the published totals. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 7 Nshama design renders and 2 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. 1 additional DLD images are from the dated project album mirrored by Continental Club. Selected photographs depict the structure under construction.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 4 and 7. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 3049 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 8 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. Several printed totals differ from the displayed component sums. Both total columns for 2 BR Type C show 1,028.49 sq ft. The selector uses the published totals.

unavailable: Verified visitor entrance, finished-building photos and current unit-specific measured areas.
